'''Dave Geraghty''' (also published as '''Dave Georaghty''') is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2001 New South Wales State Championship]] on 20 May 2001 with Echo Base Experimental Frigates, according to Luke Bartter's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2362">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-23-nsw-states-sydney-20-5-01d2362/ nsw-states-sydney-20-5-01], DeckTech (Luke "Like" Bartter, 23 May 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-23-nsw-states-sydney-20-5-01d2362/ GitHub Pages].</ref> Dave Geraghty also played at [[December 2001 Sydney Theed Palace Sealed Deck tournament]] in December 2001, according to Clarrie Brown's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3182">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-12-17-sydney-theed-palace-sealed-deckd3182/ sydney-theed-palace-sealed-deck], DeckTech (clarrie " DLOTSuckers" brown, 17 December 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-12-17-sydney-theed-palace-sealed-deckd3182/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
